title: **NASA’s $4.3 Billion Roman Space Telescope Set for Launch – 1000x Faster Than Hubble, 2500 TB of Data, and 100,000 Exoplanets Await**
text:
"**NASA’s $4.3 Billion Roman Space Telescope Set for Launch – 1000x Faster Than Hubble, 2500 TB of Data, and 100,000 Exoplanets Await**"

""
"NASA’s new space telescope, carrying a $4.3 billion mission, is poised to revolutionize astronomy. Its builders claim that with its 300‑megapixel camera, it will scan vast swaths of the cosmos 1,000 times faster than Hubble. While Hubble transmitted about 172 terabytes of data over 30 years, *Roman* is expected to send back a staggering 2,500 terabytes in just its first five years."

"A curious twist: the telescope uses a 7.9‑foot mirror originally built for a classified spy satellite. Beyond decoding the mysteries of dark matter and dark energy, Roman is equipped with a cutting‑edge instrument that can identify more than 100,000 new exoplanets within 18 months – compared to just over 6,200 discovered so far."

"The image quality is so sharp that displaying a single full‑resolution picture would require half a million 4K televisions. Riding atop a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, the spacecraft will head toward the Sun‑Earth Lagrange Point 2, where it will unveil unprecedented insights into the expansion of the universe and the structure of galaxies.
